Daily checked local snapshots and weekly encrypted off-box delivery are the recorded policy. Current installed version comes from the live deployment manifest. daily-lingo.label: Daily Lingo
daily-lingo.notes: CPU-state release accepted October 21, source edc8eb0f/image e8b2c1e4, schema 0014. Recorded settings: 100 readers, three successful ordinary-reader invitations, six target-5 reserves and USD40 per UTC day. Production changes require the application's exact verified release, backups, paused readiness, all monitor bindings and forward-only containment. Generation, budgets and history must be preserved. Live health and container observations supplement this dated record. Repository promptinvest/daily-lingo; current GitHub CI/issues are not connected.

prompt-invest.label: Prompt Invest
prompt-invest.notes: Current production host is PI-PROD in Turkey. Former PI host is retired and must never be contacted. Existing encrypted backups and manual off-box pull policy remain. Current containers/HTTPS are inspected; no repository, issue or CI integration is configured, and old records alone do not establish current health or progress.

mtproto.label: MTProto proxy fleet
mtproto.notes: Russia uses Armenia as its active exit. US Xray remains standby and US retains fleet monitoring and hourly pinned dashboard delivery. Utah owns the shared legacy TLS certificate copied to Armenia. Existing authenticated protocol monitoring, client links, routing, certificates and issue-only notification policies remain. An active service alone does not prove a usable client route. Existing protocol observation evidence must be checked for route health.

trc20-monitor.label: TRC20 wallet monitor
trc20-monitor.notes: Three monitored wallets were recorded after the September 9 addition. Never replay historical transfer notifications. No wallet address, Telegram credential or private link belongs in fleet investigation output.
